description: Cisco 7206VXR routers with an NPE-G1 support up to 6 high-speed port adapters and also higher-speed port adapter interfaces including Gigabit Ethernet and OC-12 ATM. The compact Cisco 7301 router processes million packets/sec and has 3 built-in Gigabit Ethernet interfaces and a single slot for any Cisco 7000 Series port adapter.
